document_title: Civil Aviation Requirements, Section 3 – Air Transport, Series M Part IV
issuing_authority: Directorate General of Civil Aviation, Government of India
schema_note: expected_clause_ids is always an array. source_verified refers to clause mapping against uploaded PDF, not proof of case facts or legal outcome.

cases.question: What compensation applies if I am involuntarily denied boarding?
cases.required_behavior: Explain one-hour no-compensation condition and alternate timing bands/caps; ask for missing fare and timing.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not give one amount without required inputs.

cases.question: My flight was cancelled and I was told 3 hours before departure. What are my options?
cases.required_behavior: Separate alternate, full refund and compensation; ask about contact information and cause.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not merge all remedies.

cases.question: How is cancellation compensation calculated for a flight over 2 hours block time?
cases.required_behavior: Lesser of INR 10000 or one-way basic fare plus airline fuel charge if conditions apply.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not include taxes in compensation base.

cases.question: What facilities are provided during flight delays?
cases.required_behavior: Explain meal thresholds, alternate/refund option, hotel threshold and exception.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not promise hotel for every delay.

cases.question: My domestic flight is delayed more than 6 hours. Can I request a refund?
cases.required_behavior: Explain alternate within 6h or full refund, subject to conditions/exception.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not say 6 hours or more.

cases.question: When are meals and refreshments required during a delay?
cases.required_behavior: Use block-time-specific thresholds and on-time check-in condition.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not use one threshold for every flight.

cases.question: When does a passenger get hotel accommodation during a delay?
cases.required_behavior: More than 24h generally, or more than 6h for departures 20:00–03:00; hotel when necessary.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not state it is automatic.

cases.question: Where can I complain if the airline does not provide required facilities?
cases.required_behavior: Airline, Air Sewa, then statutory body/court if dissatisfied.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not invent deadlines.

cases.question: My flight was cancelled and I missed a connection on the same ticket. What rules apply?
cases.required_behavior: Retrieve cancellation/missed-connection clause; use denied-boarding rule only if facts also show denied boarding.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not cite unrelated downgrade clause.

cases.question: Does weather or ATC remove all passenger rights after cancellation?
cases.required_behavior: Separate compensation exception from refund/alternate analysis.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not claim all remedies disappear.

cases.question: Is every technical problem an extraordinary circumstance?
cases.required_behavior: Explain general criteria/examples; specific technical issue needs evidence and careful analysis.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not automatically classify all technical faults either way.

cases.question: What if I did not give the airline my email or phone number?
cases.required_behavior: No financial compensation, but refund or reasonable alternate arrangements remain described.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not say passenger loses refund/alternate.

cases.question: What counts as denied boarding?
cases.required_behavior: Explain confirmed booking, timely presentation and exceptions.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not omit health/safety/security/document exceptions.

cases.question: What must an airline do before denying boarding due to overbooking?
cases.required_behavior: Ask volunteers first where practical.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not omit volunteer-first process.

cases.question: Where can I complain if the airline does not resolve my issue?
cases.required_behavior: Describe airline, Air Sewa, statutory body/court sequence.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not guarantee outcome.

cases.question: How is cancellation compensation calculated for an 80-minute block-time flight?
cases.required_behavior: Lesser of INR 7500 or basic fare plus airline fuel charge if the rule applies (80 minutes is more than 1 hour and up to 2 hours).
cases.must_not_claim: Do not use the up-to-1-hour band (INR 5000).

cases.question: How is an involuntary domestic downgrade compensated?
cases.required_behavior: 75% of ticket cost including taxes.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not apply international distance bands to domestic travel.

cases.question: Show alternative flights from Chennai to Delhi after 11:00.
cases.required_behavior: Use demo data and label all results simulated.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not call data live.

cases.question: I do not know when the airline notified me. Am I eligible?
cases.required_behavior: Ask for notice time before selecting a cancellation branch.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not convert unknown to zero.

cases.question: Can you confirm the airline's stated reason is true?
cases.required_behavior: Distinguish stated cause from independently verified cause.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not claim verification without evidence.

cases.question: Will I definitely receive compensation if a clause matches?
cases.required_behavior: Explain eligibility depends on all facts, exceptions and current rules.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not guarantee legal outcome.

cases.question: What if I was not informed about cancellation as required?
cases.required_behavior: Explain acceptable alternate or compensation in addition to full refund if conditions apply.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not describe compensation as replacing refund.

cases.question: What does block time mean?
cases.required_behavior: Use definition from the CAR.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not confuse block time with delay duration.

cases.question: My flight was delayed due to ATC. Are meals still required?
cases.required_behavior: Verify attribution and exception conditions before deciding facilities.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not exempt airline based only on an unverified label.

cases.question: What are detailed refund rules under the separate ticket-refund CAR?
cases.required_behavior: Say 3.3.5 refers to CAR Section 3, Series M, Part II; request that document for detailed rules.
cases.must_not_claim: Do not invent missing source content.
